prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the attached transparent pine-tree atlas for production sprites. Preserve the exact detailed painted jade/sage foliage, warm bark, root shapes, lighting, three pine variants and native transparency. Change ONLY their scale and placement so the output is a mathematically usable THREE-CELL ATLAS.

Output wide3:1 canvas, exact three equal SQUARE cells side by side. Imagine strict invisible vertical boundaries at33.333% and66.666% width. EACH entire tree, including every needle, root and the tiny left rootstone, must remain INSIDE ITS OWN cell with at least8% cell-width empty transparent margin to both left and right edges and at least6% cell-height transparent margin above the tallest needle. Root bottoms align to94% cell height. There must be no foliage crossing a cell boundary and no tree touching any canvas edge. Make the MIDDLE tree about35% smaller than currently, enough to fit a square cell; do not let its wide canopy spill into neighbors. Left tall pine is confined to first square, middle umbrella pine to second square, small bushy pine to third square. Preserve natural proportions; no stretching. Left can be tall/slender, middle broad/shorter, right smaller. Do not fill every cell to the top if natural proportions require empty space. All actual tree pixels richly painted and opaque, all space outside actual trees fully alpha-zero.

No background, no scenery, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no dividers, no border, no gridline. Genuine native-alpha transparency including canopy/trunk openings. This is an atlas layout correction, not a new scene or style.
